children.value: Take Laplace transform in time (or other variable) to reduce PDE to ODE.
Solve the resulting ODE in space (or other variable) with boundary conditions.
Apply the inverse Laplace transform to return to the original variable.
Superpose solutions if initial/boundary conditions are decomposed in eigenfunctions.
Converts time derivatives into algebraic terms, simplifying the solution of linear PDEs.
